author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: I am fine leaving the KPI definitions agreed by hand for the moment. My priority is getting the consent validation hooks into the data contracts before we touch the forecasting logic. If we keep the metric definitions manual, the audit team can verify the legal basis without waiting for my pipeline updates. I would accept the extra friction of manual sign off on those definitions if it means the loyalty basket data stops flowing into the models until the consent records are valid. We need that clean break before the next promotion week, otherwise the whole allocation run is at risk of being challenged later.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they would accept the extra friction of manual sign-off on KPI definitions in exchange for ensuring data flow stops until consent is valid.
